nom: Exfoliating Himalayan Salt Scrub with Collagen & Stem Cells

avis.texte: I used this scrub for the first time yesterday and I really was surprised how soft my skin was after. I usually don’t have rough or dry, it’s always been smooth and soft. I’m currently 7 months pregnant and I have been dealing with the “pregnancy” neck so dry and darkening skin around my neck. I also have some dry patches on my chest and a patch in the crook of one arm. And then a dry patch on my lower back. Other than these areas I don’t have dry skin anywhere else. And when I’m not pregnant I don’t have this issue. Just wanted to give you guys a little background. Anyhow I did what the directions said and started at my legs, and moved to my arms and then body. I’m still not sure how much salt is appropriate to use but I will say be careful when rubbing it in because the salt is coarse. I focused on my dry areas the most. For some reason my skin does not peel and rejuvenate on these dry areas. Anyhow I rinsed the salt off in the shower and it left a really light scent that smells good. as I was rinsing off I could feel how soft my skin felt. After the shower I followed up with my shea butter and a different mix of oils as a moisturizer, as I usually do. I woke up this morning and my skin is not as dry as it usually is the next day. And I believe that’s what my issue was. I would moisturize after every shower but for some reason it wasn’t penetrating these dry areas enough and by the next day I would be so dry it would be itchy and tight around my chest and neck. But no, ther

Several things about this product. First of all, I bought it because I had a coupon code for like 60% off. I had been looking for a dermabrasion type paste for my face and also a rub for cellulite on my thighs so this seemed to be for both. When I got it in the mail, it had a coupon to text a number to receive a free one, which I did. So that was awesome. The smell was fine. Not too over powering. The problem for me was the texture of it I guess.... it was like it was too dry. When I put it in my hand to rub it, it would just fall off before I had a chance to rub it in. Since I had two of the bottles now since I got my free one, I mixed aloe Vera gel in one container for my legs so that it made it more paste like and easier to handle. For my face I used the other container and mixed in a Moisturize face was that I had, which made that easier to scrub my face. Once I fixed the dryness problem, it worked amazing! My skin was super soft after. Cant say much for if it’s helping with the cellulite but it certainly helps to get rid of dry skin so I’m sure in the end it’ll help the appearance. So for the price with the coupon and then getting a free product, I’d say it was worth the buy even though I had to “fix” it.

avis.titre: Non-irritating & leaves skin exfoliated, soft, supple, clean, & smelling great!
avis.texte: I love this Himalayan salt scrub! I have used several different brands of salt, sugar, and coffee scrubS in the past, and immediately noticed a positive difference with this one. Upon opening the well-packaged tub, this scrub looked finer, smoother, and creamier than most other brands I have used thus far. After reading the ingredients, I learned this is because, in addition to the salt, there is collagen and other skin boosting ingredients! Also, this brand is much finer than most salt scrubs I have used, which tend to be more corse and jagged. I did not have any irritation with this brand when used before shaving, but due to the salty nature, I don’t recommend use after shaving (salt irritates fresh tiny nicks), and I have VERY sensitive skin. After using this scrub in the shower, my skin felt so soft and smooth that I didn't even need to use lotion after! With my dry, sensitive skin, I ALWAYS need to moisturize after a shower, but this scrub moisturized and exfoliated all in one! (Although, note the directions still say to moisturize after use). I'd also like to comment on the please thank smell of this scrub. I absolutely love it! Sweet and fresh and not overbearing and artificial at all. Overall, this is an excellent product. I highly recommend it. * I am committed to providing completely honest and unbiased reviews. This and all of my reviews contain only my personal, sincere opinions. Please let me know if you found this review helpful, and feel free to comment if not

avis.titre: Gets rough & bumpy skin smooth again … AMAZING! 😍
avis.texte: As I have aged, I have been plagued by rough, bumpy skin on my arms & legs. THIS SCRUB is AMAZING! It feels great when you’re scrubbing! My skin gets smoother with every scrub! And in case you’re wondering it washes down the drain … no problem. Try it!
Great product. Bad packaging. Oils leak out of wrapping every time.

avis.titre: Helped with my face and upper back acne
avis.texte: I mainly got this to scrub my face with. Once I started using it on my face I found that it did a very good job of giving me smooth skin and reduced the redness of the little blemishes I have here and there. I started noticing I wasn’t breaking out as much and when I did, it was nowhere near as bad as before. Satisfied with my results I started using this on my upper back and chest to help with my acne there. I got the same results and it reduces the redness of the spots DRAMATICALLY! So far this is the only scrub I’ve found that does this to me. One thing to note, the scrub is a dry-ish scrub. So if you have sensitive skin, you need to mix a little with water to get a paste consistency. My mom has sensitive skin and she needed to make it very pasty in order for her to use it comfortably. I on the other hand have tougher skin so I was able to use the scrub normally with just a wet face/back. The scent smells good in the container but after washing my face after scrubbing, (to me) it leaves a scent that I don’t enjoy a whole lot. I can’t describe it. Its not unbearable and isn’t bad enough to the point to where I will stop using this product but it’s just something to note.
I just Want to thank you for a great customer service. My package came damaged. So I couldn't use the product when I called. My item was replaced. I love this product.

As someone who is severely allergic to fragrances and perfumes, it is very difficult to find beauty products that don’t irritate my skin. This didn’t cause any redness, hives, or rashes—it was only soothing to my skin! I was a bit skeptical when I purchased this product, especially with the price being a bit higher than I anticipated, but I’m so glad that I did. I haven’t been using it long enough to tell whether or not it helps with cellulite, but I can already tell that it has helped smooth my dry, bumpy skin on my arms and legs. It feels amazingly gentle and I was pleasantly surprised by how amazing it smelled. The scent is very light and fruity. I also feel better about the price now that I know that a little goes a long way and I think the jar will last a while. I’m excited to keep using!
I love this scrub. It helps to make your skin feel soft and smooth.
Amazing scrub! My go to, been buying it for years now! Leaves your body extremely soft and moisturized! The only thing I would say is that I’m not a fan of the scent (or lack there of).
At first I was a little upset looks like the short the amount but over all the products works really good.

avis.titre: Amazon won't honor M3NATURALS shop pay code to receive the next order free!
avis.texte: Love the product, however M3NATURALS put a promotional sticker ontop of the lid with a "text this code to this number, to recieve you're next one free" I followed the instructions, received my code.. (which was a shop pay code, I don't understand that considering you can only buy this product from Amazon from my understanding), that Amazon doesn't seem to accept. Called Amazon customer service, the agent kept stating she understands the information I'm providing her, for her to ask me OVER AND OVER literally 8 times a question that I had already given the information on numerous times. Agent then attempted to inform me that there was NEVER a promotion.. I HAVE THE PRODUCT AND AM ADDING A PHOTO TO THIS REVIEW for proof! Then said agent puts me on hold to "further investigate". Then tells me "oh there was a promotion but it expired" So which is it? No promotion, or expired promotion?!? Also if the promotion had ended... why didn't I receive a message stating as such instead of the code for checkout that Amazon doesn't want to honor??? Upset is an understatement considering I am a paying customer, and the Amazon agent made me feel like a liar, or a cheapskate. For the record I was going to order a new one because I'm almost out... when I grabbed it to look it up by name, that's when I seen the sticker and what exactly it entailed. I had seen the blue sticker on the white lid before, just never gave any thought to really read it honestly. Horrible customer service experience from
I finally received my order but when i did receive it the container was slightly damaged. I am very excited to try this stuff i have tried tree hug & hempz in the past.

The product had an opening after I removed the plastic packaging on the lid. But before that I assumed it was the other product I ordered that caused the leakage, but when I had smelled my hand, it was the same smell as the scrub. After removing the lid, I noticed that it was slightly opened already.

UPDATE: Jonathan from customer relations took the initiative to contact me based on my previous review. He was very professional, eager to help, and sent me a better sealed jar at no cost. That is exactly what I look for in customer service and look for in a company that stands behind their products. The fresh product is great - the textural feel, the scent, and of course, how well it works. This company has earned my trust! ORIGINAL REVIEW: I noticed that the large brown shipping envelope that contained my order was wet, even though it was a dry, sunny day. I was disappointed to see that my scrub container looked to be a little more than half full, but the plastic seal was still completely intact on the lid. Once the plastic seal was removed, it was evident that the seal had not done its job, as it was thoroughly wet on the underside of the seal, meaning a good portion of the product had leaked out during shipping or perhaps before that. It is difficult to rate the product itself as it did not have that brand new, fresh look and feel to it, since it was probably open to the air during the entire shipping process.

avis.titre: Wonderful Facial Scrub, Solid Body Exfoliator
avis.texte: I bought this product originally to use before applying my self tanner. After reading tons of reviews, it seemed like a really great option for exfoliating my sensitive/ acne prone skin. The first time I tried it, I applied all over my body while in the bath. It seemed to do a good job. My skin felt hydrated, but not greasy. I wish the smell was a little more noticeable....but over all a solid product for exfoliating your body. After using it a few times on my body, I decided to try it on my face. Now, this is where this product really shined for me. I have very sensitive acne prone skin. I have been struggling with hormonal acne on my jawline for the majority of my adult life. For about the past month or so I have been using this on my face every time I shower and my acne is gone! In the instance of using it on my face, I am appreciative of the light scent and gentle exfoliation. I love this product to use on my face and will definitely repurchase for that purpose.

I’ve ordered this twice now and both times the jar leaks all of the oil/fluid out of it into the box. So I still haven’t been able to use it yet. I will order another one and if that one leaks everywhere, I’ll go with another brand.

avis.titre: Effective natural (based on noted contents) himalayan salt scrub
avis.texte: I was looking for a himalayan salt body scrub with mostly, if not all, natural contents. This one was a winner after checking out few options on Amazon. So far, I’m satisfied with the product. I’ve used it 4x now since purchase, every other shower. I noticed my skin is smoother (pre-lotion) after each use. Although, that is to be expected with most scrubs with oil (this one says it has almond oil) and glycerin and, it will leave your shower a bit slippery for obvious reasons, but not leave your skin greasy. One thing to point out though, this one has NO SCENT WHEN APPLIED, but has a subtle sweet scent in the jar. So, if you are looking for a scented one and be able to smell it on your skin after each use, this is not the product for you. But, I was looking for natural and effective himalayan-specific scrub, so this one does the job for me ... well, so far. :-)

I was so sceptical about buying this but after using it once a week for 2 months there's such a big change. I have never worn a bikini because I had super white thick stretch marks on my upper thighs and my butt but this thing actually made a huge difference for me. I've tried other creams and oils and they made zero change. I wish I would have taken before and after photos. But here's what my thighs look like now, my stretch marks were visible around my whole thigh and now it's just the top and a little left on my hips and inner thighs. You would have been able to see a huge difference if I had taken a before picture but just taking this one makes me happy.
The picture is very deceiving. It's not even full never mind flowing over the top. I have not used the product yet so I can not attest to that aspect.

avis.titre: Amazing scent and my face feels like silk!
avis.texte: I don’t usually do reviews like this. I have used many different scrubs, from apricot to homemade ones, two other brands. This is the best one I have ever found. First of all the granules are nice and big but they dissolve in a beautiful way so it really exfoliates your skin. Second the scent is by far the best scent I’ve ever had in a scrub. It’s invigorating. And, my face feels great afterwards. I take very good care of my skin and I’ve had plastic surgery on my eyes so I think I know what makes a face look good. This product really is an enhancement and I highly recommend!

Firstly, This item was sent to me half full. Maybe a damaged item or used? I was desperate to use it because of my skin being completely dry due to the heat. This item did help with the exfoliation part and my skin felt completely smooth. I’m just disappointed that I received a possible damaged item and half full… for the price that’s not cool.

avis.titre: May cause Rash or breakouts if you have sensitive skin
avis.texte: I had high hopes for this product and since it was on sale at the time of buying I figured it would be a no brainer. After reading up on reviews it seemed to be a good choice for a body scrub. I’ll break this down into three parts. First thing, The scent is very underwhelming. I like my body wash or body scrub to smell good and this didn’t really have a scent at all. Second, The moisturizing part was decent. Not bad but not great either. It goes on rough and feels like you’re washing your body with sand. And your skin comes out soft. Not bad. You also have to use a lot if you are wanting to cover your whole body. Even being sparing I used multiple scoops during the one time I used this. Third, The scrub has likely caused my skin to break out where I applied it left new red marks a few days later. Not sure if it’s just my skin’s sensitivity but It didn’t occur until after the fact that I used this body scrub. In conclusion, no great scent, feels like rubbing your skin with sand, and can cause rash or breakouts if you have sensitive skin like myself.

I absolutely love my HIMALAYAN SCRUB!! I use it every day on my face and hands to get rid of dead skin! It smells good and I LOVE IT! I see a real difference in how my skin looks and feels. This company makes a lot of different products and a good friend of mine commended this particular one. I actually bought around Christmas time and it’s lasted me until April. I will use all of their products and Highly recommend for men and women....

I had been wanting to try some exfoliating body scrub so I gave this a try and was beyond pleased! Total game changer on showering and feeling like your skin is cleansed and revived. Like a layer of dead skin had been scrubbed away and totally moisturized. All the ingredients listed on the container are good for your skin. Must Have from now on. Other brands were more oily and not as pure of a salt scrub.

avis.titre: Love it for my sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I have been using this product for several weeks now. I’ve purchased several scrubs in the past and I like this one the best. It leaves my sensitive skin feeling soft. The scent is extremely subtle, almost unnoticeable. It isn’t a heavy moisturizer, but I love that it doesn’t leave my skin feeling dried out. Many scrubs I’ve used in the past have been loaded with oils and left my skin with a greasy film; this one does NOT. I love it & will definitely purchase again!

I will definitely buy again!

The bottle design and label didn't really appeal to me, I think they could work on that a little, but the product inside jumped right up to scrub number one in my book. So highly recommend it!

I am convinced this is a must have in the shower forever. I will keep buying! This scrub makes my skin feels so smooth I had to think about applying my body lotion after I was done. It's not too rough as other salts are, it disintegrates fairly easily which makes it nice to use even on my face. I have keratosis pilaris on my arms and kept having breakouts as well as razor bumps on my legs, my legs literally feel like butter now.. instant results 🙌🏻

avis.titre: Sensitive Nose and Sensitive Skin Approved!!
avis.texte: This product was a gift for my girlfriend. Here is her review: “I have a sensitivity to products with unnatural scents, so similar products from other companies (initials TH) tend to give me a headache. This Himalayan salt scrub?? Perfect for someone like me. The salt and lychee scent is mild but soothing, and I love the way it smells! The effect that this scrub has on my skin is just as soothing; leaves my skin soft and moisturized! It is truly the perfect addition to my routine.”

I am in love with this product! Very moisturizing, leaves a glow effect to my skin, and makes my skin very soft to the touch. Doesn’t really have a smell which I actually appreciate, means it’s not all perfume. If you are looking for a product to bring moisture back to your sensitive skin, this product is for you. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!! Also, fantastic customer service. By purchasing one, I got an offer code for a free one. Very happy with this purchase.

Just what I was looking for! This scrub is not weak so if your looking for something mild, this is not it! Exfoliates well & my skin did not feel dried out after; nice, pleasant smell as well. Saw some reviews about it “bring dried out” in the container but, it’s not...just add water and mix it in your hand. I don’t do that bc I like it strong like this. I like to feel the grit! Lol I most definitely do with this product! ♥️

I think the oils and things end up settling down at the bottom after a bit so shaking it up helps bring the color back to the salt. Which is what I did before taking these snapshot. The smell was wasn’t strong which was fine. The scrub was great and it lasted a while on my skin while I was in the shower scrubbing away. I think I would get this again but I’m not sure because of the price tag. $33.41 seems a little high for this 12oz container that’s not completely full.

I’ve only used it once so far and I didn’t really enjoy the scent. I feel because it was left in the sun for a bit (Amazon drop off) the texture changed…However, I might need to give it another try. It did leave my skin smoother though. EDIT**** I had to come back and edit my review after using the product again. I LOVE IT! I can right away feel how soft it left my skin.

avis.titre: Smells amazing and my skin is so soft!

I was skeptical about this product but decided to purchase it due to all the good reviews--so glad that I did. My skin felt smoother and much more refreshed I felt like the salts really helped my moisturizer absorb more efficiently and effectively. I think it will only get better. Definitely a smart purchase!

I purchased this product based on reviews. As I am older I thought it might help with age spots on my hands. However, as you can see from the picture the mark on my hand is still there. I saw this recommended for the face. I would highly advise against this. I will add that I typically do not have particularly sensitive skin.

It provides gentle exfoliation without leaving my skin dry after use. I follow up with a light moisturizer afterwards and my sensitive skin feels super soft. I currently have two uses of this scrub: one is to follow after I dry brush a particular trouble area with cellulite, and the other is to exfoliate the pores on my waxed legs which are a bit dark from oil/dead skin trapped in them. I plan to do a 3-month update on my results.
It’s completely sealed but it’s even full with the scrub. I feel like with a more pricey scrub it should be full.

First and for most I’m a huge fan of scrubs , what intrigued me about this particular scrub is the key work “collagen and stem cells” we all know those key components play a big role in rejuvenating the skin . Love love love it!!

avis.titre: Excellent product. Don’t wait to try it. Buy it now!!
avis.texte: I just started using the Himalayan Salt Scrub and I love it. When you feel the scrub between your fingers you think that it’s going to be too abrasive on your skin, but it’s not. It is a very gentle scrub, I used it on my face as well as my body. I had a few areas on my face that were dry and the scrub gently removed it without any irritation to my face. After washing it off, my skin felt so smooth, like glass. It wasn’t dry and taught. I did moisturize afterwards which left my skin bright and glowing. I have used other salt scrubs in the past, but they have been too harsh on my skin, this is by far the best one that I have used. You only need to use a little bit of the scrub, to see results, so this will last me quite awhile. I will definitely by this one again. Definitely worth the money.

avis.titre: Best scrub I've tried; totally worth the price!
avis.texte: Was skeptical to purchase because of the price, but I took a chance after reading the reviews. I'm so glad that I did! Noticed an IMMEDIATE difference in my skin after the FIRST use. Unlike drugstore scrubs I used before, this scrub REALLY exfoliates and moisturizes my super dry skin. I was soo impressed I recommended it to my friends in a Facebook post.

Like the other reviews, the only bad thing about this item is that it doesn’t come very full- it’s like half full with product. This picture above shows how much product is remaining after one-time use. However, I would totally buy this again for the benefits alone.

I really, REALLY wanted to like this product because of the good reviews. Attached are photos of the salt scrub upon opening the container. As you can see, the product isn't filled to the top. What I found most frustrating was the super greasy residue that this scrub left behind. I read a few reviews where customers used it on their face, and I don't know how they could continue doing so w/out their skin breaking out terribly. I'm not going to return it because I've used it once, but seriously consider another product.
